swift-creek-baptist-midlothian.assessment: Swift Creek Baptist is a solid SBC congregation in the Midlothian/Chesterfield area. Southern Baptist churches affiliated with the convention hold to the Baptist Faith & Message 2000 — affirming inerrancy, salvation by grace through faith, complementarian leadership (male-only pastors/elders), and the Great Commission mandate. The church serves a growing suburban community in Chesterfield County with robust ministry programs. A strong candidate for families seeking traditional Baptist worship and doctrine.
